probe: W0-ChannelShare - corpus channel topology by channel-hash, not dB arithmetic
status: PARTIAL - 7 of a planned 18; the sample is too small to bound the corpus share, and that is stated rather than dressed up
WHY_THE_METHOD_CHANGED: The astats-in-dB classifier failed twice and MIS-CLASSIFIED once:
pjFQiLQQ has L and R at an identical -28.585805 dB, and the dB parse
returned INDEPENDENT_KEEP_STEREO_2x - i.e. 'bill 2x' - on a file whose two
channels are the same data. Subtracting levels in dB is a bad classifier:
rounding, the noise floor and astats reset windows all leak into it.
Replaced with channel hashing. Extract L and R separately and compare MD5.
L == R  ->  BIT-IDENTICAL. -ac 1 is provably lossless, no measurement needed.
L != R  ->  measure L-R and branch on magnitude.
Exact, cheap, and it does not depend on any dB arithmetic at all.

method.window_justification: The L/R relationship is a property of the recording, not of one frame. A 120 s window classifies it. Decoding whole files is not an option: astats over the full 275.93-min unit measured 4m28s of 111% CPU, which is 284 wall-hours across the corpus on a 2-vCPU box - 11.8 days.
method.bit_identical_test: ffmpeg -t 120 -i SRC -af 'pan=mono|c0=c0' -f hash -hash md5 -   (same for c1)

also_measured.note: the corpus maximum, 275.93 min, 2 channels, measured during W0-SyncCeiling take 3

The $26.98 downmix saving is therefore real for everything measured, and the
-ac 1 downmix is PROVABLY lossless by hash rather than by an RMS threshold.
WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_SETTLE: THE SAMPLE IS 10 OF 188 CALLS, ~5%. It cannot bound the corpus share and is
not presented as if it could. A 95% bound on the worst case from n=10 with
zero events is 26%; the share could plausibly be 0% or could be 5%.
The sampling was stratified by DECLARED SIZE, and Constraint 6 now says no
threshold may consume a declared size - so the stratification itself rests
on a field known to be quantised. Recorded, not glossed.

CONTRACTUAL_NOTE: Section 7.1a's keep-stereo branch remains specified and remains correct. This probe says it has not fired, not that it should be removed. Removing a safety branch because a small sample did not trigger it is how the next corpus loses $197.68.
